hypotheses.E1_boundary_contrast_emerges_before_laye: A normalized pre-MLP state by Layer 8 reaches at least 50% of final Layer-11 PC3–PC4 contrast energy on every corpus.
hypotheses.E2_early_contrast_patch_is_causally_effe: For some layer at or before 8, contrast-only residual patching recovers at least 50% of final Layer-11 contrast on every corpus.
hypotheses.E3_layer10_contrast_patch_is_nearly_suff: Layer-10 contrast-only residual patching recovers at least 80% of final Layer-11 contrast on every corpus.
hypotheses.E4_contrast_only_patch_is_not_full_logit: Even the best layer's contrast-only patch leaves more than 25% relative full-token KL on every corpus.
hypotheses.E5_middle_mlp_writes_create_the_largest_: For every corpus, the layer with largest positive direct MLP attribution to output-residual contrast lies in Layers 4–8.
hypotheses.E6_attention_never_dominates_direct_cont: At no layer or corpus does attention receive more than 50% signed attribution to that layer's output-residual contrast.
hypotheses.E7_emergence_depth_transfers_ood: The first layer reaching 50% final contrast energy differs by at most two layers across corpora.
hypotheses.E8_late_residual_patch_recovery_is_monot: Contrast recovery from residual patches is nondecreasing from Layers 7 through 10 on every corpus.
